name: Environmentally Preferable Purchasing  FY15 - Goods
description: This dataset lists goods purchased by a city government under its Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) program for fiscal year 2015. Each of the 13 records describes a purchased item, whether an EPP minimum standard was indicated, the contract start and end dates, the registration date, and the contract value. The data can be used to review which goods met environmental purchasing standards, compare contract values and terms, and assess how consistently EPP requirements were applied across purchases. It may be useful for procurement analysts, sustainability staff, and others examining municipal purchasing practices or spending on environmentally preferable goods.
